import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/instr')
import worker_instr as W
rng = random.Random(999)
worst=0
for trial in range(3000):
    mode=rng.choice(['route','admit'])
    num_edges=rng.randint(1,16)
    capacities=[rng.choice([0,1,1,2,10,1000]) for _ in range(num_edges)]
    num_commodities=rng.randint(1,8)
    slots=rng.randint(1,8)
    paths_all=[]
    for _ in range(num_commodities):
        paths=[]
        for _ in range(slots):
            length=rng.randint(1,5)
            paths.append([rng.randrange(num_edges) for _ in range(length)])
        seen=set(); unique=[]
        for p in paths:
            key=tuple(p)
            if key in seen: continue
            seen.add(key); unique.append(p)
        paths_all.append(unique)
    demands=[rng.choice([0,1,5,100,1000]) for _ in range(num_commodities)]
    bias=[rng.uniform(-100,100) for _ in range(num_edges)]
    rho=rng.choice([1,2,8])
    s=W.WorkerSolver(num_edges)
    s.configure(capacities,demands,paths_all,list(range(num_commodities)),bias,rho,mode)
    W.ITERATIONS.clear()
    s.solve()
    if W.ITERATIONS:
        worst=max(worst, W.ITERATIONS[-1]+1)
print('worst active set iterations:', worst)
PYEOF
